required_guard_failed.why: A write or destructive tool's required guard (harness/guards.py: its input schema at least) found a problem, raised, or the tool has no guard at all. Nothing ran and no card was shown; the result reads denied and the assistant corrects the arguments the message names.

confirmation_args_changed.why: The arguments of an approved action no longer match the fingerprint the confirmation bound (harness/guards.py). Nothing ran; the result reads denied and the assistant asks for the action again so the user reviews the new arguments.

no_progress_stop.why: The same tool kept failing on the same arguments, so the call that would be the third failure in a turn, or the fifth in the chat, was refused before dispatch (harness/budget.py). Nothing ran; the assistant corrects the arguments or tells the user what blocks it.
